target_customer: Data teams at enterprises in finance, healthcare, marketing and the public sector that hold sensitive personal data
problem: Companies cannot easily let analysts and ML teams use personal data without long anonymization and compliance work.
business_model: Enterprise software licence deployed in the customer's own infrastructure
product_category: Privacy preserving analytics and ML (differential privacy)

founders.name: Maxime Agostini
founders.background_notes: Cofounded AlephD, an ML startup for publisher monetization.

founders.name: Nicolas Grislain
education: Ecole Normale Superieure de Lyon (mathematics and computer science)

founders.name: Vincent Lepage
founders.background_notes: Sarus is his third startup; former CPO of Owkin.

exit.reason: YC directory lists the company as acquired; no buyer, date or terms were found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Differential privacy on arbitrary analytics and ML queries deployed inside customer data stacks is research grade, requiring privacy accounting and query rewriting.

defensibility.rationale: Deep technical know-how and integrations are hard to copy, but open source projects and larger privacy vendors worked on similar problems.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No documented incumbent copy; the company is listed as acquired by an unnamed buyer.

market_need_then: GDPR driven compliance cost and months of anonymization work for data teams, with differential privacy maturing as a practical technique by 2022.

identity.voice_and_tone: confident and benefit driven, such as Protect data. Unlock value.

brand_strength.rationale: Known mainly in privacy tech circles; other companies share the Sarus name and no source shows brand pull.

outcome_analysis: Sarus had repeat founders with a prior exit to Yahoo and Verizon Media, a hard privacy technology and a 2 million euro seed in 2020 plus YC in 2022. The directory lists it as acquired but the buyer and timing are not public, so the cause and quality of the outcome cannot be judged.
notes: The 2020 seed predates the batch by about two years. Seed amount is 2 million euros; no USD conversion recorded. Aggregators list a 500K seed in April 2022 and about 2.8M total; unverified single source figures not recorded. Competitor lists (Gretel, Privitar, Statice) come from current CB Insights and directory pages without dates, so the dated list is empty. Two outcome searches found no acquirer. The sarus.tech homepage carries no acquisition notice.
